competitors.name: Albertsons
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported Albertsons is targeting lower-income shopper leakage to Walmart, Amazon and Aldi with selective price locks, personalized deals and loyalty offers after a weak quarter. CEO Susan Morris said the retailer will make price cuts surgically by market and decision area rather than broad discounting.

competitors.name: Albertsons
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported Albertsons launched ACI Edge, consolidating 11 divisions into four regions and centralizing center-store merchandising through Merch United. The move follows a 0.8% identical-sales decline, a lowered fiscal outlook and stated need for sharper value, fresh differentiation and faster merchandising decisions.

competitors.name: National Confectioners Association / GLP-1 shoppers
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported NCA research showing GLP-1 users are not exiting indulgence categories; they are shifting toward smaller portions, premium products, better-for-you options, ingredient transparency and lower-sugar choices. NCA said broader economic pressure is affecting confectionery consumption more than GLP-1 medication use.

trends.magnitude: Albertsons is using selective price locks, personalized deals and loyalty offers rather than broad price cuts
trends.context: Premium frozen pizza will face tighter buyer scrutiny as major grocers protect price-sensitive shoppers with surgical value programs. Real Dough needs a clear role in baskets where value is defined by meal quality, portion and repeat purchase, not only low price.

trends.magnitude: Albertsons is consolidating 11 divisions into four regions and centralizing center-store merchandising
trends.context: Regional nuance still matters, but large chains are moving more assortment, supplier and pricing decisions into centralized systems. Emerging frozen brands need sharper sell-in data and chain-level category logic before regional stories can scale.

trends.magnitude: GLP-1 users remain engaged with treats but favor smaller portions, premium products and better-for-you options
trends.context: The GLP-1 impact is not a simple retreat from indulgent foods. For Real Dough, the better response is concrete portion, quality and ingredient cues that let shoppers justify a premium pizza occasion more intentionally.
